summary: This guide covers Chub character cards and lorebooks, which Bunzai reads through their SillyTavern-shaped character-card fields and the `extensions.chub` block. Cards arrive as PNG or JSON. Lorebooks may be embedded or downloaded as a standalone `character_book` entry array. Bunzai retains parsed source data in escrow while exposing supported character fields and Chub extras for editing. A same-format card export preserves original field values and applies edits, but JSON formatting or the output container may change. Conversion to another app omits Chub-specific fields that have no target equivalent. Standalone Chub lorebooks are edited as ordinary lorebook entities and exported through a supported lorebook format; their download wrapper is not preserved as a Chub-specific output. The Workbench shows Chub-tagged fields, previews custom CSS in a sealed Chub-style surface, and narrows lorebook editing to Chub's supported field shape. The Press writes character cards as CCv3 JSON with the Chub extension when present; Chub is not a lorebook output target. Common questions cover card output, portrait retention, preserved Chub fields, and standalone lorebook exports.

sections.title: What Bunzai reads
sections.summary: Bunzai reads Chub character cards as .png with text inside the image or plain .json. It does not treat Chub as its own wire format: it recognizes the SillyTavern shape underneath and keeps the extensions.chub block that rides along. Lorebooks arrive as .json embedded in a card or standalone from Chub lorebook shelf; standalone downloads are a bare character_book entry array not SillyTavern keyed worldbook map, and Bunzai recognizes that shape too. Drop on the Library for a plain-words receipt calling origin Chub CharacterHub when extras give it away; recognition is by inside content not filename. Full walkthrough lives in the importing guide.

sections.title: What comes across cleanly
sections.summary: Bunzai retains parsed source card data in escrow and exposes supported fields for editing: character identity and description, greetings, examples, prompts, creator details, tags, embedded worldbook, and expression images when present. Chub extras include chat background, custom CSS, bound preset, and related-lorebook links; the Workbench shows supported extras as Chub-tagged cards. Chub id, full path, and Stages references remain in source data even though they are not editable fields. The card image is retained as the portrait. A standalone lorebook exposes entries, keywords, and placement for editing. Retaining parsed fields does not mean the exported file has identical bytes or formatting.

sections.title: What changes when you convert to another app
sections.summary: A same-format card export preserves original field values and applies edits; JSON formatting or the output container may change. Conversion to another app omits Chub-specific fields without a target equivalent, including chat background, custom CSS, bound preset, related-lorebook links, Chub id, path, and Stages references. Shared character fields, embedded worldbooks, and expression images cross over only as far as the target supports them. A Chub card uses the SillyTavern-shaped card structure, so it can be exported as the corresponding SillyTavern card. A standalone lorebook has no Chub output target: Bunzai writes it using a supported lorebook format, such as a SillyTavern worldbook, and does not preserve the original download wrapper. Entries, keywords, and placement remain represented in the lorebook data.

sections.title: Editing on the Workbench
sections.summary: Send a piece to the Workbench as a tab and edit core character fields the same as any card; save writes the whole card so untouched parts stay. Cards with a Chub bag show Chub-tagged cards for chat background bound preset and related-lorebook links. Custom CSS opens in the CSS Workshop sealed preview mocked to Chub chat-bubble classes never applied to Bunzai interface. Open a lorebook and Write for Chub narrows to character_book floor emphasizing priority secondary triggers and before-character after-character placement only; hiding never deletes fields.

sections.title: Exporting back out
sections.summary: Stage for the Press via right-click or rail; each run exports staged pieces to one target. Chub is a character target writing the same file SillyTavern would get: .json CCv3 with extensions.chub bag if present. Embedded worldbook rides automatically. Plain .txt or .md available for text. Chub is not a lorebook target; export standalone lorebooks as SillyTavern or another lorebook-capable app instead. Other app targets apply the drop story.

sections.title: Common questions
sections.summary: Does the card return exactly as it was? A same-format export preserves its original field values with edits applied, but formatting or container may differ. Imported PNG cards export as JSON, which Chub and SillyTavern can read. Bunzai retains the art as the portrait and stores source data in escrow. Chub background and custom CSS remain Chub fields and are not copied into unrelated formats. An embedded worldbook can be edited separately and re-embedded for a target that supports it. Standalone Chub lorebooks export through a supported lorebook format, such as a SillyTavern worldbook; the original download wrapper is not preserved.
